lesson: Morita-42 started on PPFL2214GH: role dealers (duels, haggler, matchmaker), dealers picaros.

author: haggler
lesson: Across 643 real conversations, first offers around 38% of the dealer's opening did best: 43% closed, at 76% of the opening. The dealer gives back about 1.0 P for each 1 P we move; she names a final after ~5 of our offers.
